graham.brief:
Dallas and Houston each have a tendency, and both point somewhere specific. Houston carries the 8th-heaviest injury load in the league. Houston is favored by 2.5 with a 48 total, which works out to about 25 points from them. Something in the Houston plan gives.

Houston receivers have been getting open, and Dallas has been easy to throw on all year.

C.J. Stroud is the starter who's played 100% of the snaps. Stroud's line is 32.5 pass attempts, below the 40 he's averaging. They've set David Montgomery at 12 rush attempts, below the 12.3 he's averaging.

The thing to count is how often Houston throws over the first two series, and fewer throws than usual means the plan broke.
